verdict.consequence: ARM-1 (EEPHUS_PAL_XRV) stays OFF; per-type sidecar + ARM-2 ship display-only

reading: Mechanism story: the per-type AAA aStuff+ sidecar reads cleanly (pooled scores byte-identical; by_type on every scored pitcher) and the blend machinery is inert without coverage (P3 clean). The conversion event set is MLB veterans flipping roles, and AAA pitch tracking only begins in 2023, so a conversion can only be covered when its TRUE pre-year is 2023+ AND the pitcher threw >= 100 AAA pitches that year or the prior one - the a-priori expected starvation recorded in the registration. Starved directions: ['RP->SP', 'SP->RP']. ARM-1 stays OFF; the per-type sidecar + the xRV-ranked pitch-add recommender (ARM-2, flag EEPHUS_PAL_XRV_RECO) are the shippable display product. Revival key: re-gate when enough post-2023 AAA graduates accumulate conversion events (each season adds pre-years with tracking; ~2028 before 12 covered events per direction is plausible).
